# uup_channel (Data Source)

Looks up a Channel by its `id` or its `name`. Channels are added and verified in the dashboard, because most need a code or a link confirmed by a person.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uup_channel" "oncall" {
  project_id = data.uup_project.main.id
  name       = "On-call Slack"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) The Project the Channel belongs to, `prj_…`.

### Optional

- `id` (String) The Channel's identifier, `chn_…`.
- `name` (String) The Channel's name.

### Read-Only

- `state` (String) `active`, `awaiting_link`, `awaiting_code` or `disabled`.
- `type` (String) Its type, such as `email`, `slack`, `discord`, `telegram`, `msteams`, `inbox`, `sms` or `whatsapp`.
